question:
The given chart represents the import of various consumer goods (in Lakh tons) during the years 2016 - 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5c99750008f070b758d73e0d8f4335a40d042572b3b5bbb98f1e1ed7b6fa11b.png] 

What is the ratio of the number of cosmetics imported in years 2016 and 2020 together to that of toys in the year 2018 and 2020 together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of cosmetics are imported in year 2016 and 2020 = 35 + 25

⇒ 60 (in lakh tons)

Total number of toys are imported in year 2018 and 2020 = 25 + 20

⇒ 45 (in lakh tons)

Ratio = 60 : 45

⇒ 4 : 3

**∴ Required answer is 4 : 3.**
